PostgreSQL 18: pg_checksums
https://www.postgresql.org/docs/18/app-pgchecksums.html
Publisher: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group
Sections: Description; Options --check, --enable, --pgdata
Rights: PostgreSQL License; https://www.postgresql.org/about/licence/
Change notice: selected excerpts; whitespace normalized. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt and licenses/.
The server must be shut down cleanly before running pg_checksums.
When verifying checksums, the exit status is zero if there are no checksum errors, and nonzero if at least one checksum failure is detected.
When enabling checksums, each relation file block with a changed checksum is rewritten in-place.
--enable Enables checksums.
--check Checks checksums. This is the default mode if nothing else is specified.
